packs.title: CC0 PBR textures
packs.copyright: Photographic PBR materials from ambientCG (https://ambientcg.com): bark, rock, grass, ground, sand and forest floor -- all CC0 1.0 (public domain). The list is in CREDITS.txt inside the pack.
packs.notes: The materials the engine's terrain, forest and demos wear: colour, normal and roughness maps at 1K. With this installed the engine reads them from this machine and does not reach ambientCG.

packs.title: Bust gallery demo world
packs.copyright: 'Marble Bust 01' by Rico Cilliers from Poly Haven, and the floor, wall, ceiling and beam materials from ambientCG -- all CC0 1.0 (public domain). Full attribution in CREDITS.txt inside the pack.
packs.notes: A hall of 120 marble busts on plinths, each a six-level MSFT_lod chain, with a polished parquet floor and dark beams overhead. An ordinary glTF file -- a viewer that does not know the extension draws every bust at its finest level.
